Package com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.infrastructure.persistence.adapter

Class AgentRepositoryAdapter

java.lang.Object
com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.infrastructure.persistence.adapter.AgentRepositoryAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
AgentRepository
@Component public class AgentRepositoryAdapter extends Object implements AgentRepository
Spring Data JPA-backed adapter for the AgentRepository domain port.

The agent aggregate spans four tables (the parent agents row plus three child tables — tools, MCP servers, team). On save(com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.domain.agent.Agent) the adapter replaces the child rows wholesale: a deleteByAgentId (or deleteByParentAgentId) followed by a saveAll of the new rows inside a single transaction. This is simpler than diffing and adequate at the v1 64-user scale (REQ-NFR-005).

listByOwner(com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.domain.user.UserId, com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.domain.shared.Cursor, int) uses the same pageSize + 1 fetch + trim keyset strategy as ApiKeyRepositoryAdapter. The follow-up child-row fetches happen per parent (small N at v1 scale); a future optimization could batch them in a single query if list sizes ever become a concern.
